content: 1. In children and adolescents presenting with signs and symptoms of tuberculosis (TB), should decentralized TB services for children and adolescents be implemented instead of centralized TB services provided at referral or tertiary hospital levels? 2. In children and adolescents who have been exposed to TB, should decentralized TB prevention and care services for children and adolescents be utilized instead of centralized prevention and care services at referral or tertiary hospital levels to improve the coverage of TB preventive treatment among eligible children and adolescents? 3. In children and adolescents with signs and symptoms of TB, should family-centered, integrated services be adopted instead of standard, non-family-centered, non-integrated services? 4. In children and adolescents exposed to TB, should family-centered, integrated services be used instead of standard, non-family-centered, non-integrated services to enhance the coverage of TB preventive treatment among eligible children and adolescents? 5.
